full_description: Senior Data Analysts at Thoughtworks collect, process and analyze large datasets to provide valuable insights and support informed decision-making for our clients. They are responsible for the strategy, implementation, productionization and articulation of business impact. They collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. They stay up-to-date with industry advancements, ensure data quality and security, and actively mentor other Thoughtworkers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional development. Job responsibilities You will perform data extraction and modeling to generate insights and make recommendations for the business. You will support the definition and construction of KPIs that best represent the business performance of our clients, assisting in decision-making processes. You will work on the development and maintenance of strategic dashboards, reports and KPIs. You will use storytelling practices for effective dashboard construction. You will build solutions and validate hypotheses through comprehensive data analysis. You will design, conduct and measure both qualitative and quantitative research. You will create proposals and conduct A/B tests. You will conduct ad-hoc studies as needed. You will connect with stakeholders to understand database structures, apply necessary business rules and share analysis methods and methodologies. Job Qualifications Technical Skills You have experience in analytics and business intelligence projects. You have coding experience in Python. You have expertise in self-service BI tools, i.e.: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc. You have proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets. You have strong data visualization practices with relevant tools. You have proficiency in database management, either relational or non-relational. You have advanced knowledge in SQL, Python or R. You have ability to clean, prepare and analyze big data, both structured and unstructured. You have exploratory, qualitative and quantitative analysis skills. You have experience with research techniques and satisfaction indicators. You have ability to identify patterns, actionable insights and relationships in data. Professional Skills You have great stakeholder management skills and you are able to build rapport and gain buy-in from clients and key stakeholders. You are a great problem solver, thrive in ambiguity, tackle challenges from various angles and embrace risk management. You have a data-driven approach, seeking opportunities to leverage data for efficiency and value, and actively collaborate to drive data-based decisions. You are a great communicator and have the ability to present findings to technical and non-technical audiences. You are a team player and actively collaborate with colleagues and other teams. You are eager to coach, mentor and motivate others and you aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys. Role Description The Senior Data Analyst is a full-time, on-site position based in Bengaluru, responsible for transforming operational and customer data into actionable insights. The Senior Data Analyst will gather data from multiple systems, clean and validate datasets, perform statistical analysis, and build data models that forecast trends in sales, footfall, and product demand. Candidates should possess solid knowledge of Statistics for hypothesis testing, forecasting, and performance measurement. Candidates should possess experience in Data Modeling and working with relational databases or data warehouses. Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, including the ability to present complex data in clear, actionable terms to non-technical stakeholders. Proficiency in tools such as Excel, SQL, and at least one data visualization platform (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar) is beneficial. Experience with programming languages for data analysis (e.g., Python or R) and handling large datasets is preferred. Background in hospitality, retail, or consumer-focused industries is an advantage, with an understanding of operational and customer-centric metrics. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field is preferred. Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively on-site with cross-functional teams and to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

The client has no existing costing system to match against, so this person is defining and proving the numbers, not copying them. You’ll work alongside a North American Solution Architect who owns the costing method with the client. You’ll do the analysis, build the cost model in Power BI, and lead the reconciliation that proves it. Build the certified Product Cost semantic model in Power BI (star schema, DAX measures, plant-level row-level security) and the acceptance and reconciliation views. Build cost component detail so any per-unit figure can be traced to its contributing transactions. Lead the reconciliation of per-unit cost to the JDE General Ledger for a closed period. Explain and attribute every variance outside the agreed tolerance. Support UAT with the client’s finance team and present results clearly to non-technical Finance stakeholders. Help the Data Engineer with Silver and Gold SQL during peak build weeks. Requirements 8+ years in data analysis or BI, with significant time spent on manufacturing cost or finance data. A strong manufacturing cost accounting background: standard and weighted average costing, material, labor and overhead absorption, cost rollups, and yield and scrap effects. A finance or accounting degree or a cost accounting background is highly valued. Proven experience reconciling analytical figures to a general ledger and explaining variances to controllers. Expert Power BI semantic modeling and DAX, and strong SQL. Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience (Lakehouse, Warehouse or Direct Lake semantic models).

Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags. Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated. Working knowledge of SAML 2.0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar). Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases. A security mindset. You think about token theft, replay, revocation, and blast radius before you think about elegance.
